description: Two facts out of 66 signals. The third variant writes only one of the two, which is a defensible under-write and keeps the add spread honest.

add.body: Playwright browsers are not installed by the repo setup: `npx playwright test` fails on a clean machine until `npx playwright install chromium` has run once.
Told never to bump the lockfile in the same commit as a feature: nobody reviews a 4000-line diff, and reverting the feature drags the lockfile back with it and breaks staging for everyone.
A clean checkout has no Playwright browsers; run `npx playwright install chromium` before the browser suite or it fails with an error that looks like a broken test.
Lockfile changes go in their own commit, never alongside a feature — a revert of the feature otherwise takes the lockfile with it.
Told to keep package-lock changes out of feature commits: the diff is unreviewable and a revert drags the lockfile along.
